subject: Save some iterations for a variable

messages.author: f8a4136bfeaed71c
messages.subject: Save some iterations for a variable
parts:
Hi all,

Suppose I run a model with 1000 iterations. For almost all variables I need to save all the iterations for summary calculation. For some variables I only need to save the last 50 iterations (from the 951th iteration to the 1000th).

How should I specify that in the stan codes?

Kind regards,
Tran.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Save some iterations for a variable
parts:
You also want to monitor all your quantities of interest
for convergence.

We'll probably have some more flexibility along these lines
by allowing you stop and restart Stan in a year or so, but we're
not going to build this in directly because our algorithms assume
the same numbers of draws for each parameter in a sample.

- Bob
